home.summary: The Detroit Red Wings are projected to start John Gibson in goal for their game against the Flyers. The team is dealing with injuries to Marco Kasper (upper body), Mason Appleton (undisclosed), and J.T. Compher (undisclosed), all listed as out. Lucas Raymond has been moved to the third line with Nate Danielson shifting to the first line, indicating a lineup adjustment ahead of the game.
